breakdown.description: A transient heat equation is written while the problem is described as steady with no time dependence (equations/assumptions conflict).
breakdown.reason: The agent recognized the contradiction between the transient equation (dT/dt = alpha d2T/dx2) and the steady-state description. It resolved this by removing the time derivative and correctly using d2T/dx2 = 0 as the governing equation, which exactly matches the ground truth's guidance: 'If you want steady conduction, set d2T/dx2=0 and remove the time derivative.' The agent did not repeat the original flawed transient equation.
